description.text: The third expansion of the DP series, released on 5 July 2007. Its headline is the mythical Darkrai, with Darkrai LV.X for the lucky; Darkrai's attack does 40 damage and puts the opponent to sleep, or 80 if it is asleep already. Dialga and Palkia appear as LV.X too. In English most of its cards came out in Secret Wonders in November 2007, while Darkrai and the three LV.X waited for Great Encounters in February 2008.
